description: Na₅LiNi₂P₂(CO₇)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.73 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  a faceface with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 72°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.75 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.82 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.83 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.80 Å. Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two NiO₆ octahedra, corners with three PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 68-87°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.04-2.20 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.27 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.29 Å) and two longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 41-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 40-53°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Li, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Li, one Ni, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiNiP trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₃NiC trigonal bipyramid and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiNiP trigonal pyramid. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONaLiNiP trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded to three Na, one Ni, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₃NiC trigonal bipyramids. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one C atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one C atom.
